explanation: Son of King David and Bathsheba, who is chosen to succeed his father as king over Israel.
Another son of King David who attempts to seize the throne before Solomon, but ultimately fails.
The king of Israel who is near death at the beginning of 1 Kings; he gives advice to his son Solomon on how to rule the kingdom.
David's wife and Solomon's mother, who helps ensure that Solomon becomes king.
A prophet who supports Solomon and warns David about Adonijah's plans to take the throne.
A priest who also supports Solomon and helps install him as king.
A young woman who serves and cares for the aging King David, but has no sexual contact with him.
